SELECT fl.id, fl.node_id AS nodeId, n.name AS nodeName, fl.forward_id AS forwardId, f.name AS forwardName, fl.user_id AS userId, u.user AS userName, fl.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, t.name AS tunnelName, fl.user_tunnel_id AS userTunnelId, fl.raw_in_flow AS rawInFlow, fl.raw_out_flow AS rawOutFlow, fl.billed_in_flow AS billedInFlow, fl.billed_out_flow AS billedOutFlow, fl.billing_mode AS billingMode, fl.traffic_ratio AS trafficRatio, fl.service_name AS serviceName, fl.created_time AS createdTime
ORDER BY fl.created_time DESC, fl.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(fl.raw_in_flow), 0) AS rawInFlow, COALESCE(SUM(fl.raw_out_flow), 0) AS rawOutFlow, COALESCE(SUM(fl.billed_in_flow), 0) AS billedInFlow, COALESCE(SUM(fl.billed_out_flow), 0) AS billedOutFlow
